title: internal/runconfig/doc.go still calls the runners.toml format 'ticks' to publish' beside a doc ticfac now owns
body: doc.go's migrator paragraph ends 'writing is authoring and the format is ticks' to publish', while the authoring doc and schema it describes now live in internal/runconfig (vendored by this tick) and the execution half of the format is ticfac's. The sentence about tk config migrate being the only writer is probably still right; the ownership clause is not, and the same paragraph should say which half (execution vs tracker tables) each claim covers. Comment-only, no behaviour.
